Below is a quick‑look list of the **official Canadian statutory holidays that create a “long weekend”** (i.e., the holiday falls on a Monday or a Friday) for the year 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, it does not create a long weekend unless you take a bridge day, which is not part of the statutory holiday schedule.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island) | Monday | ✅ | Creates a 4‑day weekend (Mon‑Sun). |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | ✅ | Creates a 4‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun). |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day (all provinces except Quebec) | Monday | ✅ | Creates a 4‑day weekend (Mon‑Sun). |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day (all provinces) | Monday | ✅ | Creates a 4‑day weekend (Mon‑Sun). |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Monday | ✅ | Creates a 4‑day weekend (Mon‑Sun). |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day (all provinces) | Monday | ✅ | Creates a 4‑day weekend (Mon‑Sun). |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day (all provinces) | Monday | ✅ | Creates a 4‑day weekend (Mon‑Sun). |

### Holidays that do **not** create a long weekend in 2023

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Reason |
|------|---------|-------------|--------|
| Jan 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday | Falls on weekend |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | Saturday | Falls on weekend |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | Tuesday | Falls on weekday but not Monday/Friday |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to offer “bridge day” options (e.g., taking a day off on the Thursday before Good Friday or the Tuesday after Boxing Day), you’ll need to add that logic separately, as it’s not part of the statutory holiday schedule.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need additional holiday details!
